description: This file defines the class 'testcaseCommands', which encapsulates operations for managing test case entities within the TestLink testing management system. It includes methods for creating, editing, deleting, reordering steps, setting statuses, managing keywords, handling relations, and other test case related actions. The class interfaces with database managers and utility classes to perform CRUD operations, UI preparation, and integration tasks.

classes.name: testcaseCommands
classes.description: A class providing comprehensive management of test cases within the TestLink system. It encapsulates methods for creating, editing, deleting, and managing test cases, steps, keywords, relations, statuses, and related configurations, often interfacing with database managers, templates, and external systems.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the command object with database connection, user object, and project ID. Sets permissions and loads associated tables.

methods.name: setTemplateCfg
methods.description: Assigns a configuration object for templating purposes.

methods.name: initGuiBean
methods.description: Initializes a GUI object with default values, permissions, and context for creating or editing test cases.

methods.name: initTestCaseBasicInfo
methods.description: Loads basic information for a specific test case for use in edit or step management, including author, updater, and custom fields.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Prepares the GUI object for creating a new test case, optionally within a container or parent.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new test case in the database, with optional bookmark to stay on page.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares GUI data for editing an existing test case.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Performs an update of test case data in the database.

methods.name: doAdd2testplan
methods.description: Links a test case to a test plan.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Prepares GUI for deleting a test case, showing confirmation.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Performs the actual deletion of a test case from the database.

methods.name: createStep
methods.description: Prepares GUI for creating a new step within a test case.

methods.name: doCreateStep
methods.description: Adds a new step to a test case and handles reordering.

methods.name: doCreateStepAndExit
methods.description: Creates a step and exits, typically after form submission.

methods.name: editStep
methods.description: Prepares GUI for editing an existing test case step.

methods.name: doUpdateStep
methods.description: Updates a specific step with new data.

methods.name: doUpdateStepAndExit
methods.description: Updates a step and then exits.

methods.name: doReorderSteps
methods.description: Reorders steps based on provided sequence.

methods.name: doDeleteStep
methods.description: Deletes a specific test case step.

methods.name: doCopyStep
methods.description: Creates a copy of an existing step.

methods.name: doInsertStep
methods.description: Inserts a step at a specific position within the sequence.

methods.name: doResequenceSteps
methods.description: Renumbers steps either based on a sequence string or sequential order.

methods.name: setImportance
methods.description: Sets the importance level of a test case.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a test case.

methods.name: setExecutionType
methods.description: Sets the execution type (manual/automatic) for a test case.

methods.name: setEstimatedExecDuration
methods.description: Sets the estimated execution duration for a test case.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Renders the interface for viewing or editing a test case, with user feedback and options.

methods.name: buildIdentity
methods.description: Constructs an identity object (test project ID, test case ID, version) from provided credentials.

methods.name: doAddRelation
methods.description: Creates a relation between test cases.

methods.name: doDeleteRelation
methods.description: Deletes a relation between test cases.

methods.name: doUpdateStepAndInsert
methods.description: Performs a step update followed by an insertion.

methods.name: removeKeyword
methods.description: Removes a keyword link from a test case.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Sets a test case or version to frozen (inactive).

methods.name: unfreeze
methods.description: Sets a test case or version to active.

methods.name: setIsOpen
methods.description: Marks a test case version as open or closed.

methods.name: setActiveAttr
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a test case version.

methods.name: addKeyword
methods.description: Adds keywords to a test case and possibly updates external issue trackers.

methods.name: updateTPlanLinkToTCV
methods.description: Links the latest test plan to test case version.

methods.name: doStepOperationExit
methods.description: Performs step creation/editing and then exits, refreshing the interface.

methods.name: addPlatform
methods.description: Associates platforms to a test case.

methods.name: removePlatform
methods.description: Removes platform association from a test case.
